name: Circuit Theory
description: Basic circuit concepts: voltage, current, resistance, power. Graph-theoretic development of circuit analysis, Tellegen's theorem, reciprocity theorem. Circuit analysis techniques: nodal analysis, mesh analysis, Thevenin and Norton theorems, superposition. Two-port networks: parameters, star-delta conversion. Operational amplifiers: ideal op-amp, feedback. First-order and second-order circuits: step and steady-state response. Transient analysis using Laplace transforms. Sinusoidal steady-state analysis: phasors, resonance. Power analysis: real, reactive, apparent power, power-factor. Three-phase circuits, power measurement in three-phase circuits.
